summary.name: MyPhotoAI
summary.one_liner: An AI headshot generator that trains a personal portrait model from 10–15 of your selfies and produces professional-style headshots and photos in chosen looks.
use_cases: Creating a professional headshot for a job application or LinkedIn
Making dating app photos that resemble you
Generating event, graduation or wedding portraits
Getting platform-sized crops for resumes, Instagram, Zoom backgrounds
summary.what_it_does: Users upload 10–15 photos of themselves, and the service trains a personalized portrait model on those photos. They pick up to 5 looks from 142 options across 7 categories (Professional, Dating, Lifestyle, Creative, Events, Game Day, Boudoir) and pay once per shoot before generation starts. Results are delivered as 896 × 1152-pixel PNGs in a gallery, with a Lookbook of platform-ready crops (LinkedIn, resume, Instagram, dating apps, email signature, Zoom background) delivered as a zip. The site also lists several free single-purpose photo tools, including a background remover, passport photo maker, EXIF stripper, image compressor and headshot evaluator.
notable: Pay-once shoots with no subscription: Starter US$5 (3 HD photos), Plus US$10 (10), Everything US$10 (all photos from the shoot)
Trains a personalized portrait model from the user's own uploaded photos
Lookbook with platform-specific crops and brand kit included with every unlock
Free companion tools such as background remover and passport photo maker
caveats: Paid per shoot; each new shoot requires a separate purchase
First shoot includes model training and can take over an hour
Results vary; the page notes the output depends on the photos supplied
